subject: Tide.ai tenant kickoff: invites, API keys, and role matrix
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@tide.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood tenant kickoff / next steps for API key + admin invites

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at Tide.ai is excited to move forward. We're ready to get our Redwood tenant set up so our engineers can start prototyping. High-level asks:

- Create a workspace for tide-prod and tide-staging
- Seed two service accounts (one for ingestion, one for inference testing)
- Provision initial admin invites (3 seats) + a billing contact

I've attached a short CSV with the user emails and desired roles (see "tide-access-matrix.xlsx"). Could you share a proposed kickoff plan and any prerequisites we should complete from our side?

Quick context: our infra lead (Aisha, copied on follow-ups) runs the service account rotations. We expect a pilot in the US region.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Shah
Head of ML Platform, Tide.ai
Attachments: tide-access-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@tide.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood tenant kickoff / next steps for API key + admin invites

Hi Samir — great to hear. Looping in Monica (CS lead) and Jordan (implementation) to own onboarding.

Proposed kickoff plan (high level):
1) Wed 12/8 — short sync (30m) to confirm member list + pilot scope (we can do PST-friendly times)
2) By Fri 12/10 — Redwood provisions tide-staging workspace, seeds two service accounts, and sends admin invites
3) Week of 12/13 — integration sprint: ingest pipeline test + inference smoke tests (3 clear prompts)
4) 12/17 — pilot review and next steps (scale to prod)

Action items for Tide: confirm the user list in the attached matrix and confirm whether you want API keys delivered directly in the console or rotated into your KMS via our API (recommended for production).

I've attached a short mutual-action-plan (MAP-Tide-implementation-plan.pdf) that Jordan will use to track tasks.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-Tide-implementation-plan.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@tide.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood tenant kickoff / next steps for API key + admin invites

Samir — thanks for the matrix. I reviewed and have a couple of clarifying questions:

- You listed "platform-admin" for three users; do you want one owner with full admin and two delegated admins, or three owners? Owners have entitlement to billing and SSO config.
- For the service accounts: do you need long-lived keys or short-lived keys with our rotation endpoint? We usually recommend short-lived keys + KMS for production.

Deliverables we'll hand off on provisioning day:
- Workspace created: tide-staging (ephemeral) and tide-prod (reserved)
- Admin invites sent (accept link expires in 7 days)
- Two service accounts created; keys available in console and a rotation token endpoint (we will not email keys)
- Implementation checklist ticket in HubSpot (link in MAP)

I've attached a short guidance file with best practices for service accounts ("service-account-guidance.txt"). If you confirm owner model and key preferences, we'll lock the schedule and send invites on Fri 12/10.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: service-account-guidance.txt (txt)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@tide.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood tenant kickoff / next steps for API key + admin invites

Quick technical follow-up from the implementation side:

- For the ingestion service account we recommend a scoped token with write-only ingestion permissions. For inference testing, create a read-only model-inference role.
- Please confirm whether Tide wants API traffic routed through our US-west region (lower latency) or the multi-region gateway. We'll default to US-west for the pilot.
- DocuSign SOW is ready (link below). If legal confirms, we can provision reserved prod capacity after pilot.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/tide-sow-8742
HubSpot implementation ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8742

Plan: we'll provision staging workspace and invites on Fri 12/10 at 09:00 PT. After you accept invites, we'll run a 45-minute setup session to seed API keys and test end-to-end. Let us know if 09:00 PT works.

—Jordan
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@tide.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood tenant kickoff / next steps for API key + admin invites

All — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming: 12/10 at 09:00 PT works for our team.

Answers:
- Admin model: one owner (Aisha <aisha@tide.ai>) + two delegated admins as you recommended.
- Service accounts: short-lived keys with rotation endpoint preferred; we'll integrate with our HashiCorp Vault (we'll share the KMS details in the kickoff call).
- Region: US-west for the pilot.

I'll make sure Aisha and the delegated admins accept the invites the same morning. Looking forward to the setup session.

Samir
Samir Shah
Head of ML Platform, Tide.ai
